page: The UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 32 vCPUs with a shared allocation model, paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory density of 12.0 GB per core.

This server is equipped with three NVIDIA L4 graphics processing units from the Ada Lovelace architecture family, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. The configuration does not include local storage, meaning external block storage must be attached for persistent data. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The shared CPU allocation model presents a potential performance tradeoff for workloads requiring sustained, non-burstable CPU execution. However, the high system memory capacity and triple NVIDIA L4 GPU configuration make this server suitable for memory-intensive GPU workloads, such as machine learning inference, data science pipelines, and parallelized graphics processing.
